description: Where the corpus departs from upstream, and why. A case may be listed only once. The labels hold for draft 2020-12 with format asserted and patterns read as ECMA-262 regular expressions with the u flag. `make test-corpus` checks every label that can be checked by validating instances, which includes the corrected ones.

$schema.description: The schema of this file, for an editor.

exclude.description: The upstream cases that the corpus leaves out. A case is left out when one of its schemas is not valid draft 2020-12 or does not resolve, or when a test case of the test suite does not say what draft 2020-12 requires of a schema that stands on its own: such a pair has no answer.

override.description: The cases whose labels are not upstream's.

CasePath.description: The path of a case below corpus/, starting with its collection.

Exclusion.description: Upstream cases that the corpus leaves out.

reason.description: Why the cases have no place in the corpus.

cases.description: What is left out. An entry is a case id, or a folder followed by /* for every case below it. For the test suite a folder is one test case, or one file.

Override.description: The labels that cases get in place of upstream's.

note.description: What is wrong with upstream's label. It is copied into the case.json of every case listed.

a_subsumes_b.description: The label the cases get in place of upstream's: whether a.json accepts every instance valid under b.json; null when the corpus claims nothing.

b_subsumes_a.description: The same for the other direction.

cases.description: The ids of the cases that get these labels.
